coreAreas.title: AI-Powered Development
coreAreas.line: Turning ideas into working digital experiences with AI.
coreAreas.description: I use AI-assisted development to create responsive websites, landing pages, small applications, tools and prototypes. AI is an important part of my workflow — helping me plan solutions, generate and understand code, debug problems, improve interfaces and move from an idea to a working result faster.

coreAreas.title: E-Commerce
coreAreas.line: I understand both how an online store looks and how it operates.
coreAreas.description: I have hands-on experience with e-commerce and Shopify, including store setup, customization, product management, inventory, presentation and day-to-day store operations.

coreAreas.title: Creative Design & Media
coreAreas.description: I create visual content across digital design, graphics, promotional materials, landing pages and video. I enjoy taking an idea or message and transforming it into visuals that communicate clearly and grab attention.

coreAreas.title: Business & Entrepreneurship
coreAreas.line: I don't only create for businesses. I understand what it takes to run one.
coreAreas.description: Alongside my digital work, I have hands-on experience running businesses in flex printing and clothing. This experience has helped me understand the practical side of business — working with customers, handling products, managing design requirements, production, sales and day-to-day operations.

process: Understand the problem and define what needs to be built.
Plan the experience, structure and visual direction.
Use AI-assisted development and modern tools to turn the concept into a working product.
Refine the design, functionality and overall experience.
